stock-invisibility-belt-pace.scope: Stock Belt activation paid 50 IS, retained the stat-115 −300 modifier for the stance comparison and showed the normal 68 s duration. The disposable pose command supplied the measured stance; it did not prove automatic activation or cleanup.

targeting.source: GOB 701 defines selector 4, a 6 m caster radius and viral TestFunction 2.
targeting.runtime: The aura filters hostility, view, floor, range and sight before the per-recipient viral contest. Both defense modifiers require a successful roll.
targeting.test: PR729 observed the native deflection line, no defense modifiers on the eligible miss, and no contest for the ally and the out-of-range opponent. PR574 verified the 6.00/6.01 m split, and PR588 verified sight exclusion. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/729#issuecomment-7073944169 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/574 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/588#issuecomment-7054857954

notes.61: PR729 confirms activation costs 5 IS and scheduled pulses continue to debit 3 every 5 s when every eligible recipient deflects. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/729#issuecomment-7073944169
